feed.title: The CISO dilemma: Why AI speed makes security basics essential
feed.summary: The CyberRisk Alliance Cybersecurity Summit highlighted that while AI speeds up attack vectors, it doesn't replace the need for fundamental security practices. Experts emphasized that AI lowers the barrier for adversaries to deploy decades-old attacks, making basic operational flaws like broken identity management and unpatched vulnerabilities more critical. The consensus was that disciplined execution of core security practices, strong identity and access management, and zero-trust architectures are essential defenses against accelerated AI-driven threats.
